sqlQuery.sqlText:
SELECT RESUMO.*, L1.TC_SHIPMENT_ID FROM ((SELECT RF.CREATED_DTTM, RF.DATA, RF.LOJA, RF.TURNO, RF.VALOR_EQUIP, RF.CD, RF."FA/IN", RF."SO/IN", RF."VL", RF."VE", RF."AV", RF."FA/IN$", RF."SO/IN$", RF."VL$", RF."VE$", RF."AV$", RF.CATEGORIA, RF.ENCAIXE, RF.OLPN, RF.OBS, SUM(RF.FA) AS FA, SUM(RF.SO) AS SO, SUM(RF."FA$") AS "FA$", SUM(RF. "SO$") AS "SO$", SUM(RF.VALOR) AS VALOR, SUM(RF.VOLUME_ESPERADO) AS VOLUME_ESPERADO, SUM(RF.VOLUME_CONFERIDO) AS VOLUME_CONFERIDO FROM ((SELECT BRESUMO_FINAL.CREATED_DTTM, BRESUMO_FINAL.DATA, BRESUMO_FINAL.LOJA, BRESUMO_FINAL.TURNO, BRESUMO_FINAL.VALOR_EQUIP, BRESUMO_FINAL.CD, BRESUMO_FINAL."FA/IN", BRESUMO_FINAL."SO/IN", BRESUMO_FINAL."VL", BRESUMO_FINAL."VE", BRESUMO_FINAL."AV", BRESUMO_FINAL."FA/IN$", BRESUMO_FINAL."SO/IN$", BRESUMO_FINAL."VL$", BRESUMO_FINAL."VE$", BRESUMO_FINAL."AV$", BRESUMO_FINAL.CATEGORIA, BRESUMO_FINAL.ENCAIXE, BRESUMO_FINAL.OLPN, BRESUMO_FINAL.OBS, --BRESUMO_FINAL.ITEM_NAME, --BRESUMO_FINAL.PRODUTO, SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL.FA) AS FA, SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL.SO) AS SO, SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL."FA$") AS "FA$", SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL. "SO$") AS "SO$", SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL.VALOR) AS VALOR, SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL.VOLUME_ESPERADO) AS VOLUME_ESPERADO, SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL.VOLUME_CONFERIDO) AS VOLUME_CONFERIDO FROM ((SELECT B_FINAL.ITEM_NAME, B_FINAL.PRODUTO, B_FINAL.CREATED_DTTM, B_FINAL.DATA, B_FINAL.LOJA, B_FINAL.TURNO, B_FINAL.VLR_GERAL_PROD AS VALOR, B_FINAL.EXPECTED_QUANTITY AS VOLUME_ESPERADO, B_FINAL.COUNT_QUANTITY AS VOLUME_CONFERIDO, ' ' AS VALOR_EQUIP, B_FINAL.CD, B_FINAL.FALTA AS FA, B_FINAL.SOBRA AS SO, ' ' AS "FA/IN", ' ' AS "SO/IN", ' ' AS "VL", ' ' AS "VE", ' ' AS "AV", B_FINAL.VLR_FALTA "FA$", B_FINAL.VLR_SOBRA AS "SO$", ' ' AS "FA/IN$", ' ' AS "SO/IN$", ' ' AS "VL$", ' ' AS "VE$", ' ' AS "AV$", B_FINAL.CATEGORIA, ' ' AS ENCAIXE, B_FINAL.OLPN AS OLPN, ' ' AS OBS FROM ((SELECT LAR.CREATED_DTTM, LAR.TC_SHIPMENT_ID, LAR.TC_LPN_ID AS OLPN, LAR.DEST_FACILITY_ALIAS_ID AS LOJA, CAST(LAR.CREATED_DTTM AS DATE) AS DATA, CASE WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<6 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT) > 21 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<14 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS TURNO, LAR.AUDITOR_USERID, LAR.PACKER_USERID, B.ITEM_NAME, B.ITEM AS PRODUTO, B.EMB_FINAL, B.QTY_UOM, B.CATEGORIA, LOCN.DSP_LOCN, --B.UNIT_COST AS CUSTO_UNITARIO, MAX(CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) END) AS CUSTO_UNITARIO, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE CASE WHEN LD.QTY_UOM_ID=970753 THEN LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR ELSE LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END END AS EXPECTED_QUANTITY, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE CASE WHEN LD.QTY_UOM_ID=970753 THEN LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR ELSE LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END END AS "Fat", CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE CASE WHEN LD.QTY_UOM_ID=970753 THEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR ELSE LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END END AS COUNT_QUANTITY, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE CASE WHEN LD.QTY_UOM_ID=970753 THEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR ELSE LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END END AS "Conf", AVG(CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000) *(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000)) END ELSE CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY) *(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*(LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY) END END ) AS VLR_GERAL_PROD, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(LOCN.DSP_LOCN,2,3) IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS PAR, /*CASE WHEN SUBSTR(LOCN.DSP_LOCN,2,3) IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN B.UNIT_COST * (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000) ELSE B.UNIT_COST * LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY END ELSE 0 END AS VLR_PAR_AUDITADO,*/ AVG(CASE WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000) *(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000)) END ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_PAR_AUDITADO,
/*CASE WHEN SUBSTR(LOCN.DSP_LOCN,2,3) IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN B.UNIT_COST * (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000) ELSE B.UNIT_COST * LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY END ELSE 0 END AS VLR_PAR_ESPERADO,*/ AVG(CASE WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000) *(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000)) END ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_PAR_ESPERADO, CASE WHEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY < LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/ 1000 ELSE (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END ELSE 0 END AS FALTA, CASE WHEN LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY < LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/ 1000 ELSE (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/B.EMB_FINAL END ELSE 0 END AS SOBRA, AVG(CASE WHEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY < LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY THEN
CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN --((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/ 1000)*B.UNIT_COST CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN ((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/ 1000) *(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/1000) END ELSE CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN ((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)) *(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)) END END
ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_FALTA, /*CASE WHEN LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY < LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/ 1000)*B.UNIT_COST ELSE (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)*B.UNIT_COST END ELSE 0 END AS VLR_SOBRA,*/ AVG(CASE WHEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY > LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY THEN
CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN --((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/ 1000)*B.UNIT_COST CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN ((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/ 1000) *(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/1000) END ELSE CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN ((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)) *(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)) END END
ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_SOBRA,
/*CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/ 1000)*B.UNIT_COST ELSE (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)*B.UNIT_COST END AS VLR_DIF, */ AVG(CASE WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000) *(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/100)) END WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT!=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY) *(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)) END ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_PAR_ESPERADO, AVG(CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN ((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/1000) *(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/1000)
END ELSE CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY) * (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*(LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY) END END) AS VLR_DIF, LAR.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID as CD, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN
(LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/1000 ELSE (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END AS Erros --, --(LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/B.EMB_FINAL AS Erros FROM
LPN_AUDIT_RESULTS LAR JOIN LPN L ON L.TC_LPN_ID=LAR.TC_LPN_ID AND L.INBOUND_OUTBOUND_INDICATOR='O' JOIN LPN_DETAIL LD ON LD.LPN_ID=L.LPN_ID
-- Busca dados do produto -- JOIN ((SELECT IC.ITEM_ID, IC.ITEM_NAME, IC.REF_FIELD8 as COMPRADOR, IC.DESCRIPTION AS ITEM, IC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID, CASE WHEN IPC.QUANTITY IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE MAX(IPC.QUANTITY) END AS EMB_FINAL, --ICC.UNIT_COST, IC.VARIABLE_WEIGHT, IPC.IS_STD, max(IPC.QUANTITY)as QUANTITY, UB.DESCRIPTION AS BASE_UOM, UQ.DESCRIPTION AS QTY_UOM, PC.DESCRIPTION AS "CLASSE DE PRODUTO", SC.CODE_DESC AS CATEGORIA, IFMW.SHELF_DAYS, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER as BASE, IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT as ALTURA, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER * IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT AS PALETIZACAO, CASE WHEN IC.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN 1000 ELSE 1 END AS FAT_CNV_VW --, --ICC.AUDIT_LAST_UPDATED_DTTM as DATA_AT FROM ITEM_CBO IC LEFT JOIN ITEM_PACKAGE_CBO IPC ON IC.ITEM_ID=IPC.ITEM_ID AND IPC.IS_STD = 1 AND IPC.PACKAGE_UOM_ID='173' AND IPC.MARK_FOR_DELETION=0 LEFT JOIN SIZE_UOM UB ON IC.BASE_STORAGE_UOM_ID=UB.SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN SIZE_UOM UQ ON IC.DISPLAY_QTY_UOM_ID=UQ.SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CLASS PC ON PC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID=IC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID LEFT JOIN ITEM_MASTER IM ON IC.ITEM_ID=IM.ITEM_ID /*LEFT JOIN ITEM_COST_CBO ICC ON ICC.ITEM_ID=IC.ITEM_ID*/ LEFT JOIN ITEM_FACILITY_MAPPING_WMS IFMW ON IFMW.ITEM_ID=IC.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_ID=IM.PROD_CATGRY AND SC.REC_TYPE='B' AND SC.CODE_TYPE='060' GROUP BY IC.ITEM_ID, IC.ITEM_NAME, IC.REF_FIELD8, IC.DESCRIPTION, IC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID, IPC.QUANTITY, UB.DESCRIPTION, UQ.DESCRIPTION, PC.DESCRIPTION, IPC.IS_STD, IC. DISPLAY_QTY_UOM_ID, IPC.PACKAGE_UOM_ID, IC.DATABASE_QTY_UOM_ID, IC.DISPLAY_QTY_UOM_ID, SC.CODE_DESC, IC.VARIABLE_WEIGHT, --ICC.UNIT_COST, IFMW.SHELF_DAYS, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER, IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER * IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT --, --ICC.AUDIT_LAST_UPDATED_DTTM ORDER BY IC.ITEM_NAME )B)
ON B.ITEM_ID=LAR.ITEM_ID AND LD.ITEM_ID=B.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN /*BUSCA LOCAL DE PICKIN*/ ((SELECT LC.DSP_LOCN, PLD.ITEM_ID, LC.AISLE FROM LOCN_HDR LC JOIN PICK_LOCN_DTL PLD ON LC.LOCN_ID=PLD.LOCN_ID WHERE SKU_DEDCTN_TYPE='P' )LOCN) ON LAR.ITEM_ID=LOCN.ITEM_ID
---INVENTORY_TYPE-- LEFT JOIN ((SELECT SC.CODE_ID AS INVENTORY_TYPE, SC.SHORT_DESC AS FA_ALIAS, 'CD '||SC.SHORT_DESC AS OPERACAO FROM SYS_CODE SC WHERE SC.REC_TYPE='B' AND SC.CODE_TYPE='064' )INVN_TYPE) ON INVN_TYPE.INVENTORY_TYPE=LD.INVENTORY_TYPE
/*WHERE LAR.TC_LPN_ID='529513'*/ WHERE LAR.CREATED_DTTM=(SELECT MAX(AUD.CREATED_DTTM) FROM LPN_AUDIT_RESULTS AUD WHERE AUD.ITEM_ID=LAR.ITEM_ID AND AUD.DEST_FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=LAR.DEST_FACILITY_ALIAS_ID AND AUD.TC_LPN_ID=LAR.TC_LPN_ID AND AUD.TC_SHIPMENT_ID=LAR.TC_SHIPMENT_ID) GROUP BY LAR.TC_SHIPMENT_ID, LAR.TC_LPN_ID, LAR.DEST_FACILITY_ALIAS_ID, CAST(LAR.CREATED_DTTM AS DATE), CASE WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<6 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT) > 21 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<14 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, LAR.AUDITOR_USERID, LAR.PACKER_USERID, B.ITEM_NAME, B.ITEM, B.EMB_FINAL, B.QTY_UOM, B.CATEGORIA, LOCN.DSP_LOCN, LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR, LD.STD_PACK_QTY, LD.QTY_UOM_ID, LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY, B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT, LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY, LD.INVENTORY_TYPE, B.EMB_FINAL, LAR.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID, LAR.CREATED_DTTM /* WHERE LAR.QA_FLAG='3' */
)B_FINAL) --WHERE -- B_FINAL.OLPN='680429' GROUP BY B_FINAL.CREATED_DTTM, B_FINAL.DATA, B_FINAL.LOJA, B_FINAL.TURNO, B_FINAL.VLR_GERAL_PROD, B_FINAL.EXPECTED_QUANTITY, B_FINAL.COUNT_QUANTITY, ' ', B_FINAL.CD, B_FINAL.FALTA, B_FINAL.SOBRA, ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', B_FINAL.VLR_FALTA, B_FINAL.VLR_SOBRA, ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', B_FINAL.CATEGORIA, ' ', B_FINAL.OLPN, ' ' , B_FINAL.ITEM_NAME, B_FINAL.PRODUTO )BRESUMO_FINAL) /*WHERE BRESUMO_FINAL.OLPN IN ('926822')*/ GROUP BY BRESUMO_FINAL.ITEM_NAME, BRESUMO_FINAL.PRODUTO, BRESUMO_FINAL.CREATED_DTTM, BRESUMO_FINAL.DATA, BRESUMO_FINAL.LOJA, BRESUMO_FINAL.TURNO, BRESUMO_FINAL.VALOR_EQUIP, BRESUMO_FINAL.CD, BRESUMO_FINAL."FA/IN", BRESUMO_FINAL."SO/IN", BRESUMO_FINAL."VL", BRESUMO_FINAL."VE", BRESUMO_FINAL."AV", BRESUMO_FINAL."FA/IN$", BRESUMO_FINAL."SO/IN$", BRESUMO_FINAL."VL$", BRESUMO_FINAL."VE$", BRESUMO_FINAL."AV$", BRESUMO_FINAL.CATEGORIA, BRESUMO_FINAL.ENCAIXE, BRESUMO_FINAL.OLPN, BRESUMO_FINAL.OBS )RF) GROUP BY RF.CREATED_DTTM, RF.DATA, RF.LOJA, RF.TURNO, RF.VALOR_EQUIP, RF.CD, RF."FA/IN", RF."SO/IN", RF."VL", RF."VE", RF."AV", RF."FA/IN$", RF."SO/IN$", RF."VL$", RF."VE$", RF."AV$", RF.CATEGORIA, RF.ENCAIXE, RF.OLPN, RF.OBS)RESUMO) LEFT JOIN LPN L1 ON RESUMO.OLPN = L1.TC_LPN_ID

sqlQuery.name: SQL2
sqlQuery.sqlText:
SELECT * FROM ((SELECT B_FINAL.CD, B_FINAL.DATA as "Data", B_FINAL.LOJA as "Nº Loja", ' ' AS "Nº NF", B_FINAL.OLPN AS OLPN, B_FINAL.ITEM_NAME as "Cod Prod", ' ' as "Seção", B_FINAL.PRODUTO as "Descrição", B_FINAL.EMB_FINAL EMBALAGEM, B_FINAL.QTY_UOM as "UOM QTY", 'UN' as "Unidade", B_FINAL.PAR, SUM(B_FINAL."Fat") AS "Fat", SUM(B_FINAL."Conf") AS "Conf", SUM(B_FINAL."Conf")- SUM(B_FINAL."Fat") as "Dif", B_FINAL.CUSTO_UNITARIO, SUM(B_FINAL.VLR_DIF) AS "Total", CASE WHEN (SUM(B_FINAL.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)-SUM(B_FINAL.COUNT_QUANTITY)) > 0 THEN 'FA' WHEN (SUM(B_FINAL.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)-SUM(B_FINAL.COUNT_QUANTITY)) < 0 THEN 'SO' ELSE 'OK' END AS Motivo, ABS(sum(B_FINAL.Erros)) as "Erros", CASE WHEN (SUM(B_FINAL.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)-SUM(B_FINAL.COUNT_QUANTITY)) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN (SUM(B_FINAL.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)-SUM(B_FINAL.COUNT_QUANTITY)) < 0 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS "Cód Oc", B_FINAL.DSP_LOCN as "Local", B_FINAL.TC_SHIPMENT_ID as "Embarque", ' ' As ENCAIXE, ' ' as OBS, B_FINAL.CATEGORIA, B_FINAL.PACKER_USERID as "Separador"
FROM ((SELECT LAR.TC_SHIPMENT_ID, LAR.TC_LPN_ID AS OLPN, LAR.DEST_FACILITY_ALIAS_ID AS LOJA, CAST(LAR.CREATED_DTTM AS DATE) AS DATA, CASE WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<6 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT) > 21 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<14 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS TURNO, LAR.AUDITOR_USERID, LAR.PACKER_USERID, B.ITEM_NAME, B.ITEM AS PRODUTO, B.EMB_FINAL, B.PAR, B.QTY_UOM, B.CATEGORIA, LOCN.DSP_LOCN, --B.UNIT_COST AS CUSTO_UNITARIO, CUSTO.UNIT_COST AS CUSTO_UNITARIO, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY END AS EXPECTED_QUANTITY, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY END AS "Fat", CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY END AS COUNT_QUANTITY, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY END AS "Conf", CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY) /1000)*CUSTO.UNIT_COST ELSE (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY) *CUSTO.UNIT_COST END AS VLR_GERAL_PROD, CASE WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000)) *CUSTO.UNIT_COST WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT!=1 THEN (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)*CUSTO.UNIT_COST ELSE 0 END AS VLR_PAR_AUDITADO, CASE WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000)) *CUSTO.UNIT_COST WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT!=1 THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)*CUSTO.UNIT_COST ELSE 0 END AS VLR_PAR_ESPERADO, CASE WHEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY < LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/ 1000 ELSE (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/B.EMB_FINAL END ELSE 0 END AS FALTA, CASE WHEN LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY < LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/ 1000 ELSE (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/B.EMB_FINAL END ELSE 0 END AS SOBRA, CASE WHEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY < LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/1000) *CUSTO.UNIT_COST ELSE
((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)) *CUSTO.UNIT_COST END ELSE 0 END AS VLR_FALTA, CASE WHEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY > LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY THEN
CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN
((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/1000) *CUSTO.UNIT_COST ELSE ((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)) *CUSTO.UNIT_COST END ELSE 0 END AS VLR_SOBRA, /*CASE WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/100)) *CUSTO.UNIT_COST WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT!=1 THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY) *CUSTO.UNIT_COST ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_PAR_ESPERADO,*/ CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN
((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/1000)*CUSTO.UNIT_COST ELSE (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)*CUSTO.UNIT_COST
END AS VLR_DIF, LAR.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID as CD, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN
(LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/1000 ELSE (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/B.EMB_FINAL END AS Erros
FROM
LPN_AUDIT_RESULTS LAR JOIN LPN L ON L.TC_LPN_ID=LAR.TC_LPN_ID AND L.INBOUND_OUTBOUND_INDICATOR='O' JOIN ((SELECT LISTA.TC_LPN_ID, LISTA.ITEM_ID, INVN_TYPE_AUX.INVENTORY_TYPE, INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS, ICC.UNIT_COST FROM ((SELECT L.TC_LPN_ID, LD.INVENTORY_TYPE, LD.ITEM_ID FROM LPN_DETAIL LD JOIN LPN L ON L.LPN_ID=LD.LPN_ID AND L.INBOUND_OUTBOUND_INDICATOR='O' --WHERE -- L.TC_LPN_ID='631128'
UNION SELECT LAR.TC_LPN_ID, '' INVENTORY_TYPE, LAR.ITEM_ID FROM LPN_AUDIT_RESULTS LAR --WHERE -- LAR.TC_LPN_ID='631128' )LISTA) JOIN ((SELECT L.TC_LPN_ID, LD.INVENTORY_TYPE FROM LPN_DETAIL LD JOIN LPN L ON L.LPN_ID=LD.LPN_ID AND L.INBOUND_OUTBOUND_INDICATOR='O' --WHERE -- L.TC_LPN_ID='631128' GROUP BY L.TC_LPN_ID, LD.INVENTORY_TYPE )INVN_TYPE_AUX) ON INVN_TYPE_AUX.TC_LPN_ID=LISTA.TC_LPN_ID JOIN ((SELECT SC.CODE_ID AS INVENTORY_TYPE, SC.SHORT_DESC AS FA_ALIAS, 'CD '||SC.SHORT_DESC AS OPERACAO FROM SYS_CODE SC WHERE SC.REC_TYPE='B' AND SC.CODE_TYPE='064' )INVN_TYPE) ON INVN_TYPE.INVENTORY_TYPE=INVN_TYPE_AUX.INVENTORY_TYPE JOIN ITEM_COST_CBO ICC ON LISTA.ITEM_ID=ICC.ITEM_ID JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ICC.FACILITY_ID AND FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS GROUP BY LISTA.TC_LPN_ID, LISTA.ITEM_ID, INVN_TYPE_AUX.INVENTORY_TYPE, INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS, ICC.UNIT_COST )CUSTO) ON L.TC_LPN_ID=CUSTO.TC_LPN_ID -- Busca dados do produto -- JOIN ((SELECT IC.ITEM_ID, IC.ITEM_NAME, IC.REF_FIELD8 as COMPRADOR, IC.DESCRIPTION AS ITEM, IC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID, CASE WHEN IPC.QUANTITY IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE MAX(IPC.QUANTITY) END AS EMB_FINAL, --ICC.UNIT_COST, IC.VARIABLE_WEIGHT, IPC.IS_STD, CASE WHEN IC.REF_FIELD1 IS NOT NULL THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS PAR, max(IPC.QUANTITY)as QUANTITY, UB.DESCRIPTION AS BASE_UOM, UQ.DESCRIPTION AS QTY_UOM, PC.DESCRIPTION AS "CLASSE DE PRODUTO", SC.CODE_DESC AS CATEGORIA, IFMW.SHELF_DAYS, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER as BASE, IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT as ALTURA, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER * IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT AS PALETIZACAO, CASE WHEN IC.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN 1000 ELSE 1 END AS FAT_CNV_VW --, --ICC.AUDIT_LAST_UPDATED_DTTM as DATA_AT FROM ITEM_CBO IC LEFT JOIN ITEM_PACKAGE_CBO IPC ON IC.ITEM_ID=IPC.ITEM_ID AND IPC.IS_STD = 1 AND IPC.PACKAGE_UOM_ID='173' AND IPC.MARK_FOR_DELETION=0 LEFT JOIN SIZE_UOM UB ON IC.BASE_STORAGE_UOM_ID=UB.SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN SIZE_UOM UQ ON IC.DISPLAY_QTY_UOM_ID=UQ.SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CLASS PC ON PC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID=IC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID LEFT JOIN ITEM_MASTER IM ON IC.ITEM_ID=IM.ITEM_ID /*LEFT JOIN ITEM_COST_CBO ICC ON ICC.ITEM_ID=IC.ITEM_ID*/ LEFT JOIN ITEM_FACILITY_MAPPING_WMS IFMW ON IFMW.ITEM_ID=IC.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_ID=IM.PROD_CATGRY AND SC.REC_TYPE='B' AND SC.CODE_TYPE='060' GROUP BY IC.ITEM_ID, IC.ITEM_NAME, IC.REF_FIELD1, IC.REF_FIELD8, IC.DESCRIPTION, IC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID, IPC.QUANTITY, UB.DESCRIPTION, UQ.DESCRIPTION, PC.DESCRIPTION, IPC.IS_STD, IC. DISPLAY_QTY_UOM_ID, IPC.PACKAGE_UOM_ID, IC.DATABASE_QTY_UOM_ID, IC.DISPLAY_QTY_UOM_ID, SC.CODE_DESC, IC.VARIABLE_WEIGHT, --ICC.UNIT_COST, IFMW.SHELF_DAYS, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER, IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER * IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT --, --ICC.AUDIT_LAST_UPDATED_DTTM ORDER BY IC.ITEM_NAME )B)
ON B.ITEM_ID=LAR.ITEM_ID AND B.ITEM_ID=CUSTO.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN /*BUSCA LOCAL DE PICKIN*/ ((SELECT LC.DSP_LOCN, PLD.ITEM_ID, LC.AISLE, PLD.INVN_TYPE FROM LOCN_HDR LC JOIN PICK_LOCN_DTL PLD ON LC.LOCN_ID=PLD.LOCN_ID WHERE SKU_DEDCTN_TYPE='P' )LOCN) ON LAR.ITEM_ID=LOCN.ITEM_ID AND LOCN.INVN_TYPE=CUSTO.INVENTORY_TYPE /*WHERE LAR.TC_LPN_ID='529513'*/
GROUP BY LAR.TC_SHIPMENT_ID, LAR.TC_LPN_ID, LAR.DEST_FACILITY_ALIAS_ID, CAST(LAR.CREATED_DTTM AS DATE), CASE WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<6 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT) > 21 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<14 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, LAR.AUDITOR_USERID, LAR.PACKER_USERID, B.ITEM_NAME, B.ITEM, B.EMB_FINAL, B.QTY_UOM, B.CATEGORIA, B.PAR, LOCN.DSP_LOCN, CUSTO.UNIT_COST, --LD.QTY_UOM_ID, --LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR, LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY, LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY, B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT, LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY, --LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR, --LD.STD_PACK_QTY, LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY, --LD.INVENTORY_TYPE, B.EMB_FINAL, LAR.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID, LOCN.AISLE )B_FINAL) GROUP BY B_FINAL.CD, B_FINAL.DATA, B_FINAL.LOJA, '', B_FINAL.OLPN, B_FINAL.ITEM_NAME, B_FINAL.EMB_FINAL, '', B_FINAL.PRODUTO, B_FINAL.QTY_UOM, '', B_FINAL.PAR, --B_FINAL.TURNO, B_FINAL.CUSTO_UNITARIO, '', '', B_FINAL.DSP_LOCN, B_FINAL.TC_SHIPMENT_ID, ' ', ' ', B_FINAL.CATEGORIA, B_FINAL.PACKER_USERID )RES) WHERE RES.Motivo<>'OK' AND RES.OLPN NOT IN '146960'

sqlQuery.sqlText: SELECT TRUNC(BASE.DATA) AS DATA, COUNT(DISTINCT BASE.OLPN) AS oLPN, SUM(BASE.VALOR) AS VALOR, SUM(BASE.VOLUME_ESPERADO) AS VOLUME_ESPERADO, SUM(BASE.FA) AS FALTA, SUM(BASE.SO) AS SOBRA, SUM(BASE.FA) + SUM(BASE.SO) AS ERROS, CASE WHEN SUM(BASE.VOLUME_ESPERADO) > 0 THEN (SUM(BASE.FA) + SUM(BASE.SO)) / SUM(BASE.VOLUME_ESPERADO) ELSE 0 END AS INDICE FROM ( SELECT RESUMO.*, L1.TC_SHIPMENT_ID FROM ((SELECT RF.CREATED_DTTM, RF.DATA, RF.LOJA, RF.TURNO, RF.VALOR_EQUIP, RF.CD, RF."FA/IN", RF."SO/IN", RF."VL", RF."VE", RF."AV", RF."FA/IN$", RF."SO/IN$", RF."VL$", RF."VE$", RF."AV$", RF.CATEGORIA, RF.ENCAIXE, RF.OLPN, RF.OBS, SUM(RF.FA) AS FA, SUM(RF.SO) AS SO, SUM(RF."FA$") AS "FA$", SUM(RF."SO$") AS "SO$", SUM(RF.VALOR) AS VALOR, SUM(RF.VOLUME_ESPERADO) AS VOLUME_ESPERADO, SUM(RF.VOLUME_CONFERIDO) AS VOLUME_CONFERIDO FROM ((SELECT BRESUMO_FINAL.CREATED_DTTM, BRESUMO_FINAL.DATA, BRESUMO_FINAL.LOJA, BRESUMO_FINAL.TURNO, BRESUMO_FINAL.VALOR_EQUIP, BRESUMO_FINAL.CD, BRESUMO_FINAL."FA/IN", BRESUMO_FINAL."SO/IN", BRESUMO_FINAL."VL", BRESUMO_FINAL."VE", BRESUMO_FINAL."AV", BRESUMO_FINAL."FA/IN$", BRESUMO_FINAL."SO/IN$", BRESUMO_FINAL."VL$", BRESUMO_FINAL."VE$", BRESUMO_FINAL."AV$", BRESUMO_FINAL.CATEGORIA, BRESUMO_FINAL.ENCAIXE, BRESUMO_FINAL.OLPN, BRESUMO_FINAL.OBS, SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL.FA) AS FA, SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL.SO) AS SO, SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL."FA$") AS "FA$", SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL."SO$") AS "SO$", SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL.VALOR) AS VALOR, SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL.VOLUME_ESPERADO) AS VOLUME_ESPERADO, SUM(BRESUMO_FINAL.VOLUME_CONFERIDO) AS VOLUME_CONFERIDO FROM ((SELECT B_FINAL.ITEM_NAME, B_FINAL.PRODUTO, B_FINAL.CREATED_DTTM, B_FINAL.DATA, B_FINAL.LOJA, B_FINAL.TURNO, B_FINAL.VLR_GERAL_PROD AS VALOR, B_FINAL.EXPECTED_QUANTITY AS VOLUME_ESPERADO, B_FINAL.COUNT_QUANTITY AS VOLUME_CONFERIDO, ' ' AS VALOR_EQUIP, B_FINAL.CD, B_FINAL.FALTA AS FA, B_FINAL.SOBRA AS SO, ' ' AS "FA/IN", ' ' AS "SO/IN", ' ' AS "VL", ' ' AS "VE", ' ' AS "AV", B_FINAL.VLR_FALTA "FA$", B_FINAL.VLR_SOBRA AS "SO$", ' ' AS "FA/IN$", ' ' AS "SO/IN$", ' ' AS "VL$", ' ' AS "VE$", ' ' AS "AV$", B_FINAL.CATEGORIA, ' ' AS ENCAIXE, B_FINAL.OLPN AS OLPN, ' ' AS OBS FROM ((SELECT LAR.CREATED_DTTM, LAR.TC_SHIPMENT_ID, LAR.TC_LPN_ID AS OLPN, LAR.DEST_FACILITY_ALIAS_ID AS LOJA, CAST(LAR.CREATED_DTTM AS DATE) AS DATA, CASE WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<6 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT) > 21 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<14 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS TURNO, LAR.AUDITOR_USERID, LAR.PACKER_USERID, B.ITEM_NAME, B.ITEM AS PRODUTO, B.EMB_FINAL, B.QTY_UOM, B.CATEGORIA, LOCN.DSP_LOCN, MAX(CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) END) AS CUSTO_UNITARIO, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE CASE WHEN LD.QTY_UOM_ID=970753 THEN LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR ELSE LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END END AS EXPECTED_QUANTITY, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE CASE WHEN LD.QTY_UOM_ID=970753 THEN LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR ELSE LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END END AS "Fat", CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE CASE WHEN LD.QTY_UOM_ID=970753 THEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR ELSE LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END END AS COUNT_QUANTITY, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN ROUND(LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000,2) ELSE CASE WHEN LD.QTY_UOM_ID=970753 THEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR ELSE LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END END AS "Conf", AVG(CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000)*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000)) END ELSE CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*(LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY) END END) AS VLR_GERAL_PROD, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(LOCN.DSP_LOCN,2,3) IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS PAR, AVG(CASE WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000)*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY/1000)) END ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_PAR_AUDITADO, AVG(CASE WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000)*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000)) END ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_PAR_ESPERADO, CASE WHEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY < LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/ 1000 ELSE (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END ELSE 0 END AS FALTA, CASE WHEN LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY < LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/ 1000 ELSE (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/B.EMB_FINAL END ELSE 0 END AS SOBRA, AVG(CASE WHEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY < LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN ((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/ 1000)*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/1000) END ELSE CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN ((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY))*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)) END END ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_FALTA, AVG(CASE WHEN LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY > LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY THEN CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN ((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/ 1000)*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/1000) END ELSE CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN ((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY))*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)) END END ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_SOBRA, AVG(CASE WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/1000)*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY/100)) END WHEN LOCN.AISLE IN ('R51','R52','R53','R54') AND B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT!=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)) END ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_PAR_ESPERADO, AVG(CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN ((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/1000)*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*((LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)/1000) END ELSE CASE WHEN LD.INVENTORY_TYPE IS NULL THEN (LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY)*(SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC WHERE ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID) ELSE (SELECT MAX(ITC.UNIT_COST) FROM ITEM_COST_CBO ITC JOIN FACILITY_ALIAS FA ON FA.FACILITY_ID=ITC.FACILITY_ID WHERE FA.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=INVN_TYPE.FA_ALIAS AND ITC.ITEM_ID=LD.ITEM_ID)*(LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY-LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY) END END) AS VLR_DIF, LAR.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID as CD, CASE WHEN B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/1000 ELSE (LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY-LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY)/LD.STD_PACK_QTY END AS Erros FROM LPN_AUDIT_RESULTS LAR JOIN LPN L ON L.TC_LPN_ID=LAR.TC_LPN_ID AND L.INBOUND_OUTBOUND_INDICATOR='O' JOIN LPN_DETAIL LD ON LD.LPN_ID=L.LPN_ID JOIN ((SELECT IC.ITEM_ID, IC.ITEM_NAME, IC.REF_FIELD8 as COMPRADOR, IC.DESCRIPTION AS ITEM, IC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID, CASE WHEN IPC.QUANTITY IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE MAX(IPC.QUANTITY) END AS EMB_FINAL, IC.VARIABLE_WEIGHT, IPC.IS_STD, max(IPC.QUANTITY)as QUANTITY, UB.DESCRIPTION AS BASE_UOM, UQ.DESCRIPTION AS QTY_UOM, PC.DESCRIPTION AS "CLASSE DE PRODUTO", SC.CODE_DESC AS CATEGORIA, IFMW.SHELF_DAYS, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER as BASE, IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT as ALTURA, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER * IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT AS PALETIZACAO, CASE WHEN IC.VARIABLE_WEIGHT=1 THEN 1000 ELSE 1 END AS FAT_CNV_VW FROM ITEM_CBO IC LEFT JOIN ITEM_PACKAGE_CBO IPC ON IC.ITEM_ID=IPC.ITEM_ID AND IPC.IS_STD = 1 AND IPC.PACKAGE_UOM_ID='173' AND IPC.MARK_FOR_DELETION=0 LEFT JOIN SIZE_UOM UB ON IC.BASE_STORAGE_UOM_ID=UB.SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN SIZE_UOM UQ ON IC.DISPLAY_QTY_UOM_ID=UQ.SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CLASS PC ON PC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID=IC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID LEFT JOIN ITEM_MASTER IM ON IC.ITEM_ID=IM.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN ITEM_FACILITY_MAPPING_WMS IFMW ON IFMW.ITEM_ID=IC.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_ID=IM.PROD_CATGRY AND SC.REC_TYPE='B' AND SC.CODE_TYPE='060' GROUP BY IC.ITEM_ID, IC.ITEM_NAME, IC.REF_FIELD8, IC.DESCRIPTION, IC.PRODUCT_CLASS_ID, IPC.QUANTITY, UB.DESCRIPTION, UQ.DESCRIPTION, PC.DESCRIPTION, IPC.IS_STD, IC.DISPLAY_QTY_UOM_ID, IPC.PACKAGE_UOM_ID, IC.DATABASE_QTY_UOM_ID, SC.CODE_DESC, IC.VARIABLE_WEIGHT, IFMW.SHELF_DAYS, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER, IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT, IFMW.LPN_PER_TIER * IFMW.TIER_PER_PLT ORDER BY IC.ITEM_NAME )B) ON B.ITEM_ID=LAR.ITEM_ID AND LD.ITEM_ID=B.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN ((SELECT LC.DSP_LOCN, PLD.ITEM_ID, LC.AISLE FROM LOCN_HDR LC JOIN PICK_LOCN_DTL PLD ON LC.LOCN_ID=PLD.LOCN_ID WHERE SKU_DEDCTN_TYPE='P' )LOCN) ON LAR.ITEM_ID=LOCN.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN ((SELECT SC.CODE_ID AS INVENTORY_TYPE, SC.SHORT_DESC AS FA_ALIAS, 'CD '||SC.SHORT_DESC AS OPERACAO FROM SYS_CODE SC WHERE SC.REC_TYPE='B' AND SC.CODE_TYPE='064' )INVN_TYPE) ON INVN_TYPE.INVENTORY_TYPE=LD.INVENTORY_TYPE WHERE LAR.CREATED_DTTM=( SELECT MAX(AUD.CREATED_DTTM) FROM LPN_AUDIT_RESULTS AUD WHERE AUD.ITEM_ID=LAR.ITEM_ID AND AUD.DEST_FACILITY_ALIAS_ID=LAR.DEST_FACILITY_ALIAS_ID AND AUD.TC_LPN_ID=LAR.TC_LPN_ID AND AUD.TC_SHIPMENT_ID=LAR.TC_SHIPMENT_ID) GROUP BY LAR.TC_SHIPMENT_ID, LAR.TC_LPN_ID, LAR.DEST_FACILITY_ALIAS_ID, CAST(LAR.CREATED_DTTM AS DATE), CASE WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<6 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT) > 21 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(TO_CHAR(LAR.CREATED_DTTM,'HH24') AS FLOAT)<14 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, LAR.AUDITOR_USERID, LAR.PACKER_USERID, B.ITEM_NAME, B.ITEM, B.EMB_FINAL, B.QTY_UOM, B.CATEGORIA, LOCN.DSP_LOCN, LD.QTY_CONV_FACTOR, LD.STD_PACK_QTY, LD.QTY_UOM_ID, LAR.COUNT_QUANTITY, B.VARIABLE_WEIGHT, LAR.EXPECTED_QUANTITY, LD.INVENTORY_TYPE, LAR.FACILITY_ALIAS_ID, LAR.CREATED_DTTM )B_FINAL) GROUP BY B_FINAL.CREATED_DTTM, B_FINAL.DATA, B_FINAL.LOJA, B_FINAL.TURNO, B_FINAL.VLR_GERAL_PROD, B_FINAL.EXPECTED_QUANTITY, B_FINAL.COUNT_QUANTITY, ' ', B_FINAL.CD, B_FINAL.FALTA, B_FINAL.SOBRA, ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', B_FINAL.VLR_FALTA, B_FINAL.VLR_SOBRA, ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', B_FINAL.CATEGORIA, ' ', B_FINAL.OLPN, ' ', B_FINAL.ITEM_NAME, B_FINAL.PRODUTO )BRESUMO_FINAL) GROUP BY BRESUMO_FINAL.ITEM_NAME, BRESUMO_FINAL.PRODUTO, BRESUMO_FINAL.CREATED_DTTM, BRESUMO_FINAL.DATA, BRESUMO_FINAL.LOJA, BRESUMO_FINAL.TURNO, BRESUMO_FINAL.VALOR_EQUIP, BRESUMO_FINAL.CD, BRESUMO_FINAL."FA/IN", BRESUMO_FINAL."SO/IN", BRESUMO_FINAL."VL", BRESUMO_FINAL."VE", BRESUMO_FINAL."AV", BRESUMO_FINAL."FA/IN$", BRESUMO_FINAL."SO/IN$", BRESUMO_FINAL."VL$", BRESUMO_FINAL."VE$", BRESUMO_FINAL."AV$", BRESUMO_FINAL.CATEGORIA, BRESUMO_FINAL.ENCAIXE, BRESUMO_FINAL.OLPN, BRESUMO_FINAL.OBS )RF) GROUP BY RF.CREATED_DTTM, RF.DATA, RF.LOJA, RF.TURNO, RF.VALOR_EQUIP, RF.CD, RF."FA/IN", RF."SO/IN", RF."VL", RF."VE", RF."AV", RF."FA/IN$", RF."SO/IN$", RF."VL$", RF."VE$", RF."AV$", RF.CATEGORIA, RF.ENCAIXE, RF.OLPN, RF.OBS )RESUMO) LEFT JOIN LPN L1 ON RESUMO.OLPN = L1.TC_LPN_ID ) BASE GROUP BY TRUNC(BASE.DATA) ORDER BY TRUNC(BASE.DATA)
